card.text: The nearest millisecond pulsar: a neutron star 23 km across that turns 174 times a second.

introduction.text: PSR J0437−4715 is a neutron star 157 parsecs away, 1.4 times the Sun's mass in a ball 23 km wide. NICER's X-ray pulse fit places hot patches on it.

temperature.title: NICER hot regions
temperature.summary: Hot patches a fit to the X-ray pulse places on the surface. They are fitted shapes, not an image.
